Your caps on the home screen
A card shows what is left of each cap at a glance, and a touch on one opens the numpad over the home screen: two touches and the amount.
Your fingerprint, your face or the phone’s screen lock opens it.
Hold the card on the home screen to choose its colour and its caps, or to make it larger.
If you like, one notification in the evening asks whether there is anything to add, and only on a day you added nothing. It is the only notification Tetto has.
An example. Its time can be changed in Settings, where it can also be turned off.
